html: What you eat affects blood pressure, cholesterol and weight. Small, steady changes add up.

image.alt: Illustration of a plate with vegetables, grains and protein
image.caption: Try to fill half your plate with vegetables and fruit.
image.title: Illustration of a plate with vegetables, grains and protein

html:
• Vegetables and fruit at most meals
  • Whole grains instead of refined grains
  • Fish, beans, nuts and lean proteins
  • Healthy fats such as olive oil

• Sodium and highly processed foods
  • Sugary drinks and sweets
  • Fried foods and fatty cuts of meat
